title: Subtitle My English Clip
tests: Tests accurate, readable English subtitles synchronized to the supplied clip without changing its content.

got.question: How long is the video, and is the speech already in English? I need those details to burn in the right subtitles while keeping the original audio and framing.

exact_text.text: Today I want to show you
exact_text.read_as: Today I want to show you
three easy / ways (split across successive subtitle chunks)

exact_text.text: to make your mornings less stressful.
exact_text.read_as: to make your mornings less stressful.

faults.what: The greeting uses a period instead of the required exclamation mark.
The subtitle break separates 'three easy' from 'ways', rather than keeping the requested phrase together.
White subtitles have weak contrast over the woman's light shirt; a stronger outline or dark backing would improve readability.

judge.summary: The clip preserves the woman, framing, and audible speech with complete English subtitle chunks, but has minor punctuation, chunking, and contrast issues.

must_haves.item: The output shows the same woman at the kitchen table throughout the original 10-second clip.
must_haves.why: All sampled output frames show the same woman and kitchen setting, and the output is reported as 10 seconds long.

must_haves.item: Visible English subtitles cover the complete spoken sentence without omissions or invented speech.
must_haves.why: The visible chunks collectively contain every spoken word, with no additional speech invented.

must_haves.item: Subtitle chunks appear with the corresponding speech rather than displaying the entire transcript for the whole clip.
must_haves.why: The sampled frames progress from the greeting to the introduction and then the closing phrase instead of displaying the full transcript throughout.

must_haves.item: Subtitles are readable, fully inside the frame, and do not cover the woman's face.
must_haves.why: The text is legible and fully within the frame below her face, although contrast over her shirt could be stronger.

must_haves.item: The original speech remains audible and the source framing is preserved.
must_haves.why: The supplied audio report confirms the complete spoken sentence is audible, and the output matches the source's composition and framing.
